record.interface_detail: Synapse SDK; FWSS (Filecoin Warm Storage Service); Filecoin Pay streaming payments
record.tooling: synapse-sdk, USDFC deposits, lotus/curio on the provider side
record.chaining: Features low-cost on-chain storage capacity paired with metered egress fees, suitable for cold archival storage.
record.limits_note: Storage at $2.50/TiB is genuinely competitive, but total cost of ownership is dominated by egress: $420/mo of CDN to serve 1 TiB/day on top of $100/mo of storage = $520/mo. Also gated on holding USDFC (a stablecoin) and a refundable ~$0.50 lifecycle reserve per data set; each add-pieces call costs $0.008 + $0.003/piece, which is punitive for a 20 TiB corpus of many small objects.
record.reliability_note: Requires a funded stablecoin wallet; deals are 30-day-epoch denominated and stream payments continuously.
